div.div:
An external organisation could have their own Seqera organisation and AWS organisation. CCGCM could provide support services / software for provisioning Seqera workspaces and delivering data into these workspaces. All costs would be borne by the owning organisation using standard commercial agreements.
Data custodians would need to have their own arrangements with the "Other" organisation to assure themselves that security controls are operating correctly.
